name: flyte-benchmark
description: Reproduce the Flyte v1 vs v2 (OSS) vs Union scaling benchmarks — fan-out, long-chain, concurrency, and the swarm scale/OOM test — plus the agent-authoring benchmark measuring a coding agent's token cost to write working v1 vs v2 pipelines. Collects wall-clock, peak memory, OOM, and tokens-to-green results and compares to reference numbers.
